programme.desc: For the patrons and staff at a dusty roadside diner, the day begins as usual, but when the phones go out and a sweet old lady goes on the attack, it's a harbinger of the terror to come. As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it.

programme.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
programme.desc: Fifteen years after Hansel (Jeremy Renner) and Gretel (Gemma Arterton) defeated the wicked witch who planned to have them for her dinner, the siblings have come of age as skilled bounty hunters. Hell-bent on retribution, they have dedicated their lives to hunting down and destroying every witch still lurking in the dark forests of their homeland. As the notorious blood moon approaches, the siblings face a great evil -- one that could hold the secret to their terrifying past.

rating.system: Saskatchewan Film and Video Classification Board

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

Der Weltmeister von 2002 steckt viel Herzblut in den Klub und pflegt ein enges Verhältnis zu seinen Spielern, die er nach einem erfolgreichen Abstiegskampf zu einer Party in seiner Villa auf Ibiza einlädt.

programme.title: Originals: Ronaldo Nazário - El Presidente

Sportlich läuft es aber gut, allen voran beim Innenverteidiger-Youngster Mohammed Salisu. 26 Jahre zuvor war der jetzige Klubpräsident selbst ein großes Talent. SportsCenter
programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: Food Paradise
programme.desc: There is, of course, much more to a vacation experience than hotels, sightseeing and souvenirs. For a look at what is literally on the menu, Travel Channel takes a tour of the must-see eateries across the country where a one-of-a-kind dining experience can be had. There are places that serve lip-smacking pizza, tasty deli entrees, boatloads of bacon, fresh seafood, finger-licking deep-fried dishes, juicy steaks, hot-and-spicy favorites -- the list that can whet anyone's appetite goes on and on. Each episode focuses on a specific type of food, and there's even episodic room reserved for desserts, such as ice cream and pie.

programme.title: Kelsey Grammer's Historic Battles for America

programme.title: Kelsey Grammer's Historic Battles for America
programme.desc: Two years into the Civil War, the Union is losing the fight and desperately needs a victory to stop Robert E. Lee's push north; near Sharpsburg, Md., Union troops take a stand in a battle that could save America or end it for good.

programme.title: Kelsey Grammer's Historic Battles for America

programme.title: C'est toujours pas sorcier
programme.desc: Notre langue possède entre 2 000 et 4 000 papilles qui nous permettent de ressentir différents goûts. Mais la langue n'est pas la seule responsable du goût, en réalité c'est toute une chaîne sensorielle dont les yeux et le nez font partie qui est nécessaire pour déguster un bon petit plat. programme.title: #Investigation
programme.desc: Ce magazine d'investigation mobilise une cellule journalistique pour mener des enquêtes indépendantes. Les axes forts du projet ? Faire des révélations, apporter des preuves, donner la parole aux responsables, mais aussi aux témoins et victimes, et avoir un impact en créant le débat. Les sujets choisis concernent tous les citoyens et posent des questions sur l'évolution de la société.

programme.title: QR le débat
programme.desc: En Direct. Avec "QR le débat", Sacha Daout propose de renforcer la conversation avec les citoyens. Les initiales QR signifient "Questions/Réponses", mais représentent aussi le code "QR" que les téléspectateurs peuvent utiliser pour voter en direct via l'application OPINIO pendant l'émission. Sacha aborde des questions concrètes et pertinentes qui préoccupent les citoyens.

programme.title: Matière grise
programme.desc: Certaines pratiques artistiques peuvent modifier le cerveau et avoir un impact sur le corps et la santé. Pour les êtres humains, le contact avec l'art peut commencer très tôt. Desperate, Alfie attempts a go at monogamy with the ravishing Nikki (Sienna Miller), but even her good looks aren't enough to keep him out of trouble for long.

programme.title: The Man From Laramie
programme.desc: Will Lockhart (James Stewart) comes to the ranch town of Coronado looking for the man who is selling rifles to the Apaches, because his brother was killed with one. There he runs into Alec Waggoman (Donald Crisp), an aging rancher with a violent son named Dave (Alex Nicol). A conflict between Dave and Vic (Arthur Kennedy), Waggoman's top aid, helps Lockhart uncover the source of the rifles -- and also gets him involved in the power struggles at the Waggoman ranch.

programme.title: Downsizing
programme.desc: Mild-mannered therapist Paul Safranek and his wife, Audrey, decide to undergo a process in which scientists shrink people down to miniature size to live in small communities. The irreversible procedure allows the people to gain wealth and a life of leisure while helping to cut down on the consumption of natural resources. As Paul gets to know his new neighbors and surroundings, he soon learns that living in a tiny suburb comes with its own set of huge problems.

programme.title: Bad News Bears
programme.desc: Morris Buttermaker is a burned-out minor league baseball player who loves to drink and can't keep his hands to himself. His long-suffering lawyer arranges for him to manage a local Little League team, and Buttermaker soon finds himself the head of a rag-tag group of misfit players. Through unconventional team-building exercises and his offbeat coaching style, Buttermaker helps his hapless Bears prepare to meet their rivals, the Yankees.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut

programme.title: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Postseason Replay
programme.sub-title: 2026 ALCS Game 2: Cleveland Guardians at Tampa Bay Rays
programme.desc: Relive great games from this year's postseason.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: Blaine and Junior head to the heart of Texas looking for whitetails in the brush country. Meanwhile, Jeff pursues bucks in the Midwest's prime farmland habitat. Three hunters, two regions, one shared passion for chasing the perfect whitetail buck.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter Fish Out of Water

programme.title: Fishing & Hunting Texas

programme.title: Own The Season Tv
programme.desc: From the swamps of Florida to the forests of Wisconsin, Art and Michelle tackle two distinct hunting challenges in one action-packed episode. Their Florida hog hunt showcases tactical hunting strategies.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: The OTR crew heads to Tennessee for a turkey hunt at good friend Gary LeVox's Freedom Farms. Joining the adventure is country singer Craig Morgan, who teams up with Gary in the studio to record a song.

For veteran hunter Adam Hays, last season was unlike any other. After years of pursuing trophy whitetails, he accomplished what most hunters only dream of - taking down two record-book Boone & Crockett giants in a single season.

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries

programme.title: The Choice

programme.title: Slock Master

programme.title: Americana Outdoors Presented by Garmin

programme.desc: Inédit. Sous la direction d'Alain Marschall et d'Olivier Truchot, Les grandes gueules invitent régulièrement des interlocuteurs qui reflètent la société française dans toute sa variété et qui traitent sans tabou toutes les thématiques de la vie quotidienne qui marquent l'actualité. Une émission qui est au centre de plusieurs polémiques.

programme.title: Estelle midi : on ne va pas se mentir
programme.desc: Inédit. Du lundi au vendredi de 12h à 15h, Estelle Denis reçoit des invités qui apportent leurs savoirs, leurs enquêtes mais aussi leurs point de vue sur l'actualité. L'émission aborde tous les sujets du moment qui font débat mais aussi des sujets au plus près du quotidien des Français et qui sont au coeur de leurs préoccupations : la famille, le travail, l'école, ou encore la vie de couple.

programme.title: Fin che la barca va
programme.desc: Su una barca che naviga sul fiume Tevere, nel cuore di Roma, Piero Chiambretti invita personaggi del giornalismo, della cultura, della politica, dello sport, del costume e dello spettacolo che ci aiutano a riflettere su dove stiamo andando, in che acque navighiamo, consapevoli che siamo tutti sulla stessa barca.

programme.title: Il cavallo e la torre
programme.desc: Il fatto del giorno filtrato in 10 minuti dagli occhi e la sensibilità di Marco Damilano. Dal titolo di un libro di Vittorio Foa, la torre è il simbolo di chi fa una mossa ripetitiva, il cavallo salta e spiazza.

programme.title: Un posto al sole
programme.desc: Soap italien racontant le quotidien des habitants du prestigieux Palazzo di Palladini, ancienne propriété de l'aristocrate Napolitain Giacomo Palladini, qui surplombe le Golf de Naples et le Vésuve. A sa mort, le compte Palladini lègue l'appartement le plus prestigieux, appelé "La terrazza" en raison de sa vue imprenable, à sa dernière fille naturelle, Anna Boschi, qu'il a eue avec la gouvernante.

programme.title: Arthur the King: Insieme ad ogni costo
programme.desc: Michael Light, le capitaine d'une équipe suédoise de course d'aventure, part pour la République dominicaine avec ses trois coéquipiers, Olivia, Leo et Chik, pour un raid de cinq jours dans la jungle. Le deuxième soir, Michael nourrit un chien errant et blessé qui s'est approché du campement. A sa grande surprise, l'animal se met ensuite à les suivre. Lors d'une marche nocturne, le chien sauve même

programme.title: Il cacciatore di sogni
programme.desc: Il programma nasce dall'idea di raccontare la disabilità come molla per inseguire i propri sogni ed affermarsi nella vita. Il cacciatore di sogni, Stefano Buttafuoco, accompagnerà i telespettatori nella vita dei due protagonisti che hanno trasformato la loro disabilità in una grande spinta per non arrendersi e per realizzarsi: Andrea, appassionato di lanci col paracadute ed Enrico, amante del wind

Monarchie und auch mitverantwortlich für den Bau der gleichnamigen Bahn. Seit kurzem geht es nun mit der "Himmelstreppe" zum Wallfahrtsort. Die 91 Kilometer lange Schmalspurbahn von St. Pölten nach Mariazell glänzt mit neuen Triebwagen und heißt stolz "Himmelstreppe".

programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Die Sonderfahrt im Herbst 2014 erinnert an die Dampflok-Zeiten der KuK-Monarchie. In Teil 2 sind die Zuschauer auf den Gleisen der ehemaligen Donaumonarchie unterwegs und erleben die Geschichte der tschechischen Eisenbahn, die ihren 175. Geburtstag beging. Außerdem entdecken die Zuschauer Dampfschätze in der Slowakei und sind in Österreich Gast beim Dampflokfest "40 Jahre ÖGEG" in Ampflwang.

Qu'il s'agisse de ses propriétaires, son petit personnel ou d'autres personnalités influentes, les intrigues mêlant amour, argent, famille et trahison qui gravitent autour de l'établissement sont nombreuses.

programme.title: aktiv und gesund
programme.desc: Die Gendermedizin steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen. Doch Therapien und Medikamente auf die Bedürfnisse der Geschlechter anzupassen, ist ein längst überfälliger Schritt in der Medizin. Informiert wird zudem über die Gefahren von chronischem Sodbrennen. Auch wird erklärt, warum zärtliche Berührungen von geliebten Menschen entspannen und dabei helfen, Stress abzubauen.

programme.title: Schwarzbrot in Thailand
programme.desc: Ottmar und Tanja machen ihren Traum von der Rente unter Palmen wahr und übergeben ihre Bäckerei an ihre Tochter. 40 Jahre war die Bäckerei ihr Leben, nun wagen sie den Neustart in einer schicken Seniorenresidenz in Thailand. Hier können sie mit ihrer deutschen Rente leben wie die Könige, und auch im Pflegefall ist man bestens versorgt. Der Neuanfang in der Fremde wird zu einer Herausforderung.

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?

programme.title: Scream 2

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years.

Po niej uczestnicy uroczystości dotarli do miejsca śmierci Wielebów, gdzie

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. Miejsca skrywające wiele tajemnic, owiane legendą, miejsca o bogatej historii. W odcinku: Muzeum Praga.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Ania i Mania uczą się w gimnazjum Platerek w Warszawie. Z Brwinowa dochodzą niepokojące wieści o zdrowiu Antoniego. Po konsultacji w warszawskiej klinice, lekarz stwierdza u Winnego chorobę otępienną. Paweł wyznaje Ani miłość.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Hrabia Edwin Wąsowski z polskiego ruchu oporu uchodzi za Austriaka. Jest właścicielem majątku, wydaje przyjęcia, na których bywa wielu niemieckich generałów i dygnitarzy. Niemcy odkrywają u niego skrytkę z materiałami szpiegowskimi.

programme.title: Lena na Bałkanach
programme.desc: Lena na Bałkanach to seria podróżnicza, nie mająca wiele wspólnego z typowym przewodnikiem turystycznym. Jak opowiadać o Bałkanach to trzeba opowiedzieć o lokalnej muzyce, która odzwierciedla ten zwariowany tygiel kulturowy. To połączenie folku, punku, jazzu czy hip - hopu. Kto nie słuchał najsłynniejszego zespołu Gorana Bregovica czy No Smoking Orchestra? Lena odwiedzi jeden z bałkańskich zespołó

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie
programme.desc: Podróż przez polskie miasta i miasteczka - niegdyś tętniące życiem ośrodki społeczności żydowskiej - inspirowana książką Mordechaja Canina "Wśród ruin i popiołów".

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Marcin bezskutecznie nakłania Renatę do powrotu do ośrodka leczenia uzależnień. Kobieta wypiera swój problem i potajemnie zdobywa kolejne leki, a na widok partnera w towarzystwie koleżanki z pracy reaguje wybuchem zazdrości.

programme.title: 23. Festiwal Kultury Żydowskiej Warszawa Singera 2026
programme.desc: Reportaż pokaże najciekawsze wydarzenia tegorocznej edycji. A o tym jak zmienia się Festiwal Warszawa Singera, dlaczego stał się przestrzenią międzykulturowego dialogu, co można odkryć w kulturze żydowskiej.

programme.title: Nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Konrad zamieszkał z Małgosią nad rozlewiskiem. Pomaga w prowadzeniu pensjonatu. Marysia składa pozew o rozwód. Potem jedzie nad rozlewisko, by zorganizować wyjazd integracyjny. Spotyka Krzysztofa. Wakacyjne uczucie wciąż jest żywe.

programme.title: Nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Umiera babcia Romana. Sławek przylatuje z Kanady na jej pogrzeb. Wkrótce wyjeżdża jednak z powrotem, ku niezadowoleniu Pauli, która chciałaby mieć chłopaka przy sobie. Piernacki rozmawia z Ewą o ślubie.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Ewa Szykulska, aktorka.

programme.title: Polscy szpiedzy
programme.desc: Pułkownik Wojciech Martynowicz. Rozmowa z byłym szpiegiem, który przez lata działał na Bliskim Wschodzie - w samym sercu konfliktów, gdzie jeden błąd mógł kosztować życie. Kim był? Co widział?

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester spotyka dawnego znajomego. Nikodem prowadzi idealne życie: egzotyczne podróże, luksusowe apartamenty, niekończące się sukcesy. Sylwester zaczyna się zastanawiać, czy rodzina była najlepszym wyborem w jego życiu.

programme.title: Echo serca
programme.desc: Pobity przez nieznanych sprawców Thomas trafia nocą na ostry dyżur. Opiekę nad nim roztacza Szymek z udziałem Anity i Bartka, którzy, korzystając z okazji, w jawny sposób manifestują swoją niechęć wobec nowego pacjenta.

programme.title: Szansa na sukces. Opole 2027
programme.desc: "Szansa na sukces. Opole" to kultowy muzyczny talent show, który wyłania nowe gwiazdy polskiej sceny muzycznej, od lat bawiący wierną publiczność telewizyjnej Dwójki. Zasady programu są proste, a sama formuła pozbawiona pretensjonalności.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne

programme.title: Emisjonariusze
programme.desc: 70 lat temu Telewizja Polska wkroczyła w nowy etap swojego rozwoju. 30 kwietnia 1956 r. otwarto Warszawski Ośrodek Telewizyjny, który znacząco zwiększył zasięg nadawania, co umożliwiło dostęp do programów większej grupie odbiorców.

programme.title: Słowo daję!
programme.desc: Przełomowe wydarzenia, rozwój technologii, kluczowe decyzje, dotyczące funkcjonowania społeczeństwa. W programie powiemy o Słowach Roku 2025. Plebiscyt organizowany jest przez Instytut Języka Polskiego Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego oraz Fundację Języka Polskiego.

programme.title: Zakochaj się w Polsce
programme.desc: Kożuchów to miasto w województwie lubuskim. Na przełomie XIII i XIV wieku dostępu do niego broniły ośmiometrowe mury obronne. Do dzisiaj zachował się tu średniowieczny układ urbanistyczny.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Związek Renaty i Marcina przechodzi głęboki kryzys, co jest wynikiem narastających problemów emocjonalnych i niekontrolowanej zazdrości kobiety. Dominika stanowczo zachęca przyjaciółkę do powrotu na odwyk. Napięcie między partnerami rośnie.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane i takie, które nie są niedostępne dla wszystkich. W odcinku: magazyn orientalny Muzeum Narodowego.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kusy z pasją walczy o czystość w domu, by nie dopuścić do córeczki choroby zakaźnej. Jego bezwzględność prowadzi do konfliktów. Wikary skarcony przez księdza, że kapłańską misję zredukował do pośrednictwa pracy, ewangelizuje gminę.

programme.title: Ekstradycja
programme.desc: Nadieżda telefonuje do Sabiny i pozwala jej usłyszeć głos Basi. Mała jest chora i błaga ciocię o pomoc. Stan Basi sprawia, że Sabina podejmuje trudną decyzję. Chce wydać brata na łup oprawców Nadieżdy, wierząc, że w ten sposób uratuje ją.

programme.title: Siostry od Aniołów w sercu Afryki
programme.desc: W 1984 r. Siostry od Aniołów z podwarszawskiego Konstancina założyły swoją pierwszą placówkę misyjną w sercu Afryki. Na miejsce pierwszej misji wybrały wioskę Kampanga położoną w trudno dostępnych górach Rwandy, na wysokości ponad 2000 m.

programme.title: Rodzinka.pl
programme.desc: Dianka poznaje Ludwika i jego historie rodzinne. Adela jest świadkiem nieco dziwnej wizyty Marka podczas nieobecności Ludwika. Paula przy okazji odwiedzin u Tomka i Magdy, poznaje Sonię, dochodzi do wymiany zdań. Kacper okazuje Kubie wsparcie podczas kłótni z rodzicami. Natalia jest rozczarowana słysząc, o czym marzy jej mąż.

programme.title: Skarbiec sztuki Lubelszczyzny
programme.desc: Jednym z najcenniejszych eksponatów ze zbiorów skarbca katedry lubelskiej jest mitra precioza biskupa chełmskiego Krzysztofa Szembeka.

programme.title: Taiwan Way:3
programme.desc: 讓我們隨著Chris一同踏入台灣著名的街頭宴席世界——辦桌。Chris親身見證全女性團隊的卓越表現，以嫻熟、優雅和精準的手法呈現一場宴會，團隊的高效率讓他深感驚訝。然而，辦桌不僅僅是一場美食盛宴！飲食歷史學者史蒂芬·克魯克（Steven Crook）揭示了其背後引人入勝的歷史和深意。此外，料理大師阿勇則揭開了辦桌所獨有的菜餚，以及那些不可或缺的經典美食。別錯過Chris在這段難以置信的旅程中，深入探索台灣街頭美食文化的核心！

programme.desc: 讓我們隨著Chris一同踏入台灣著名的街頭宴席世界——辦桌。Chris親身見證全女性團隊的卓越表現，以嫻熟、優雅和精準的手法呈現一場宴會，團隊的高效率讓他深感驚訝。然而，辦桌不僅僅是一場美食盛宴！飲食歷史學者史蒂芬·克魯克（Steven Crook）揭示了其背後引人入勝的歷史和深意。此外，料理大師阿勇則揭開了辦桌所獨有的菜餚，以及那些不可或缺的經典美食。別錯過Chris在這段難以置信的旅程中，深入探索台灣街頭美食文化的核心！

programme.desc: Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: Jamie cooks a roast chicken with eggplant, bakes feta with figs & prosciutto, and creates a runner bean stew with fish. He shares tips for storing berries and chiles, finishing with a stunning pear tarte tatin.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: The Petrified Forest
programme.desc: In this film adaptation of the Robert E. Sherwood play, a drifter, a waitress and a notorious gangster cross paths in the Petrified Forest region of Arizona. Alan (Leslie Howard), a destitute writer, goes into the diner where Gabrielle (Bette Davis) works. Gabrielle dreams of studying art, and she and Alan connect as they talk about Europe and she tells him her ambitions. But gangster Duke Mantee (Humphrey Bogart) shows up and takes the customers hostage.

programme.title: It's Love I'm After
programme.desc: Despite constant bickering on and offstage, Shakespearean actors Basil Underwood (Leslie Howard) and Joyce Arden (Bette Davis) intend to marry after their closing performance in "Romeo and Juliet." But following the show, debutante Marcia West (Olivia de Havilland), smitten by Basil's interpretation of Romeo, visits backstage to declare him the perfect man for her. Basil is initially flattered by her attentions, which enrages Joyce -- until they both find Marcia more than they can handle.

programme.title: Pygmalion
programme.desc: When linguistics professor Henry Higgins (Leslie Howard) boasts that he can pass off Cockney flower girl Eliza Doolittle (Wendy Hiller) as a princess with only six months' training, Colonel George Pickering (Scott Sunderland) takes him up on the bet. Eliza moves into Higgins's home and begins her rigorous training after the professor comes to a financial agreement with her dustman father, Alfred (Wilfrid Lawson). But the plucky young woman is not the only one undergoing a transformation.

programme.title: 49th Parallel
programme.desc: In the early days of World War II, a German U-boat is sunk in Canada's Hudson Bay. Hoping to evade capture, a small band of German soldiers led by commanding officer Lieutenant Hirth (Eric Portman) attempts to cross the border into the United States, which has not yet entered the war and is officially neutral. Along the way, the German soldiers encounter brave men such as French-Canadian fur trapper Johnnie (Laurence Olivier) and soldier Andy Brock (Raymond Massey).

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: A comedic send-up of the grim circumstances of the Middle Ages as told through the story of King Arthur and framed by a modern-day murder investigation. When the mythical king of the Britons leads his knights on a quest for the Holy Grail, they face a wide array of horrors, including a persistent Black Knight, a three-headed giant, a cadre of shrubbery-challenged knights, the perilous Castle Anthrax, a killer rabbit, a house of virgins, and a handful of rude Frenchmen.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: Brian Cohen (Graham Chapman) is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother (Terry Jones), the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate (Michael Palin) and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

programme.title: Monty Python's The Meaning of Life
programme.desc: The stages of life are told through multiple sketches and songs by the British comedy troupe. The seven parts of life cover birth, growing up, war, middle age, organ transplants, old age and death. Not all stages are singular: "Part I: The Miracle of Birth" is from the perspective of an ignored woman in labor, and of a Roman Catholic couple with too many children, and "Part VII: Death" encompasses a funeral and heaven. Added are three unrelated skits placed in the beginning, middle and end.

programme.title: Elmer the Great
programme.desc: Elmer Kane (Joe E. Brown) is an arrogant but gullible baseball player who must leave his Gentryville sweetheart, Nellie (Patricia Ellis), to join the Chicago Cubs. Once on board, his teammates take advantage of his gullibility with practical jokes, and the management hides the letters that come from Nellie. When she comes to Chicago to see him play the World Series, a series of misunderstandings and bad judgments threatens to ruin both his love life and career.

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband.

programme.title: Anthony Adverse
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Hervey Allen, this expansive drama follows the many adventures of the eponymous hero (Fredric March). Abandoned at a convent by his heartless nobleman father, Don Luis (Claude Rains), Anthony is later mentored by his kind grandfather, John Bonnyfeather (Edmund Gwenn), and falls for the beautiful Angela Giuseppe (Olivia de Havilland). When circumstances separate Anthony and Angela and he embarks on a long journey, he must find his way back to her, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: They Won't Forget
programme.desc: The town of Flodden is in an uproar when a pretty student is found dead on Confederate Memorial Day, but District Attorney Griffin (Claude Rains) sees it as an opportunity. Thinking the case could propel him into the U.S. Senate, he begins an extensive smear campaign against the girl's teacher, Robert Hale (Edward Norris), an outsider who hails from New York. Despite only circumstantial evidence, Hale is convicted, and locals threaten vigilante justice if he isn't executed.

programme.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
programme.desc: Jaded World War I veteran James Allen (Paul Muni) dreams of creating a new life, but those dreams are shattered when he is implicated in a robbery and sentenced to 10 years on a chain gang. The brutal prison conditions compel James to break out and flee to Chicago, where he assumes a new identity and, over time, becomes a successful businessman. His freedom and happiness are threatened, however, when his scheming landlady (Glenda Farrell) discovers his secret and threatens to blackmail him.

programme.title: Little Caesar
programme.desc: An aspiring small-town criminal, Caesar "Rico" Bandello (Edward G. Robinson) relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, Joe Massara (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.). While Rico makes a name for himself in the underworld, Joe decides to leave the life of crime and ventures into show business, where he meets the lovely dancer Olga (Glenda Farrell). Though Rico and Joe try to honor their friendship, eventually their choices take them down dramatically different paths.

programme.title: Bulgarie, les chasseurs de démons
programme.desc: Au coeur de l'hiver, la Bulgarie vibre au rythme d'une fête païenne ancestrale : le rituel des kukeri, censé porter chance et, surtout, éloigner les démons.

programme.title: Voyage en cuisine
programme.desc: Ce voyage culinaire célèbre le dhansak, un savoureux plat indien d'origine persane à base de citrouille, présenté par le chef Mohammed Hussain. Le géographe Pierre Raffard explore ensuite les liens indo-perses, les dabbawalas et l'histoire du chaï. Enfin, Kshitij, un Indien expatrié à Prague, prépare un pav bhaji pour retrouver les saveurs épicées de son pays face à la douceur des plats tchèques.

programme.title: Invitation au voyage
programme.desc: Istanbul sous la plume d'Ahmet Altan. - En Angleterre, un jeu de boules nommé lawn bowls. - En Albanie, la soupe aux boulettes de Mimoza. - En Galice, le trésor a pris l'eau.

programme.title: Une histoire mondiale de la navigation
programme.desc: Durant l'Antiquité, la navigation assure déjà un pouvoir à ceux qui la maîtrisent, et les premières puissances maritimes envoient des vaisseaux à rames et à voiles pour contrôler des voies commerciales, faire valoir leurs revendications territoriales ou combattre la piraterie. programme.title: Le nord du Vietnam et ses montagnes

programme.title: Le sud du Vietnam au fil de l'eau
programme.desc: Des montagnes du nord au delta du Mékong, le Viêtnam offre une faune et une flore diversifiée et vulnérables. Second volet dans les zones marécageuses du sud.

programme.title: Iles Lofoten : surtourisme dans l'Arctique
programme.desc: Inédit. Alors que l'Europe suffoque, le mercure plafonne à 15°C dans les Lofoten. Un paradis pour les touristes avides de fraîcheur, un cauchemar pour l'écosystème de l'archipel norvégien. Tandis que des sherpas népalais construisent des escaliers de pierre pour protéger les paysages, des habitants excédés réclament une limitation du tourisme et le Friluftsråd local recherche un compromis.

programme.title: Maigret voit rouge
programme.desc: Un règlement de comptes en plein Paris laisse une victime inanimée sur les trottoirs de Pigalle. L'inspecteur Lognon, second du commissaire Maigret, est témoin de la scène. Il part chercher du secours. Revenu sur les lieux, il doit se rendre à l'évidence : le corps n'est plus là. Le commissaire Maigret est chargé de l'affaire. programme.title: Une vie de coléoptère : le lucane cerf-volant
programme.desc: Sur les rives de l'Oder, dans le sud-ouest de la Pologne, immersion dans le cycle de vie du lucane cerf-volant, le plus grand coléoptère d'Europe, menacé par la destruction de son habitat. L'insecte reste à l'état de larve dans un arbre mort pendant trois à huit ans, avant de se transformer en adulte pour seulement quelques semaines, consacrées à sa reproduction.

programme.title: Les vrais maîtres de la Terre : Les insectes
programme.desc: Depuis plus de 400 millions d'années, une incroyable diversité d'insectes peuple la Terre. Champions de l'adaptation, ces hexapodes ont su s'accommoder de leur habitat.

Mit dabei ist Spitzenkoch Mike Süsser, der die Teilnehmer der Woche besucht, den Wettstreit kommentiert und am Finaltag Punkte vergibt.

programme.desc: Confinement takes a dark turn for a light-hearted teenager, but provides a new beginning for an old bank robber inside the Orange County Jail; a mother who has put drugs before her son gets another chance.

programme.desc: An inmate with suspicious tax forms becomes a problem for the jail, and a murder ends with the victim burned alive in a dumpster, pitting friends and family against each other.

programme.desc: The survivor of a vicious attack shares his story in the hopes that other inmates will never commit such violence; for another inmate, it's too late to turn back the clock and now the pain of incarceration has begun to take a toll.

programme.desc: An online post from a diehard Dodgers fan leads to his arrest at a Reds game; a tragic shooting leaves one inmate facing prison time and outrage over his punishment leads to more arrests.

programme.desc: A low-level offender increases his sentence from 18 months to 16-and-a-half years after three separate counts of aggravated battery on an officer; the same inmate was banned from even non-contact visits after an affair with a prison staff nurse.

programme.desc: Inmates who become disruptive at the Penitentiary of New Mexico are transferred to the lock-up units in level 5 or 6; the trouble is, their behavior doesn't always improve; this is a lesson rookie officer Amy Lee is learning the hard way.
